verified_facts.text: The resort is surrounded by white sand and the clear waters of the Caribbean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by white sand and crystal-clear Caribbean waters, InterContinental Presidente Cancun Resort is a five-star luxury resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is at Kilometer 7.5 of Boulevard Kukulkan in Cancun's Hotel Zone.

verified_facts.text: Suites have private balconies with views of the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the charm and calm of the Caribbean Sea from luxury suites with private balconies and stunning ocean views.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool has five jacuzzis and sits just steps from the Caribbean Sea, next to the Deck Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 605 m2 pool has 5 jacuzzis and easy access to the Deck Bar and just 5 steps from the Caribbean Sea.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a jacuzzi, sauna rooms and massage rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit our premier spa, where you can relax in a jacuzzi, melt the stress away in sauna rooms, and indulge your senses in our massage rooms.

verified_facts.text: The signature 80-minute IKAL massage combines four massage techniques from around the globe.
